trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn. It pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Your real finish line is A Long Road (100% completion); once that pops, this follows immediately. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist in free roam, then the side-character finals and miscellaneous trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of Chapter 1. Just play through the opening; it pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 1. Keep playing the main missions; it pops at the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the one thing in the chapter that can be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 2. Keep playing the main missions; it pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the main missions; it pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Chapter 4. Keep playing the main missions; it pops at the chapter's end. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks the bank vault jobs during this chapter — start them here.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the final story mission in Chapter 5. This is one of only two Gold trophies, and it usually lands just before the Platinum — after the credits, free roam opens and the 100% cleanup begins.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you complete the mission Breakfast Run during the campaign. Just follow the main mission line.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you complete the mission The Cartel Heist during the campaign. Just follow the main mission line.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you complete the mission Child's Play during the campaign. Just follow the main mission line.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you complete the mission Headliners during the campaign. Just follow the main mission line.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you complete the mission VCIA Takedown during the campaign. Just follow the main mission line.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you complete the mission Operation Savage Glory during the campaign. Just follow the main mission line.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game and the real Platinum gate. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist — progress made during the story already counts. The list is lenient, roughly 60% of true completion, not everything. The big numbers: 100 optional tasks, 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults, $250,000 in Marked Bills fenced, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 42 of 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42 of 42 Drone Time Trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be done in free roam after the story. Expect this to take the bulk of the ~200-hour Platinum run.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 unique stunts across Leonida — jumps, flips and other stunt types, each distinct stunt counting once. Stunts happen naturally while driving fast over ramps and jumps; chase them deliberately on highways and stunt jumps around Vice City. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 of 397 stunts, so keep going past 250 — the extra 50 count toward A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, drone races and the other map activities. Open the map and look for activity icons; one round of each is enough. Do it early: the activities you sample here are the same ones the 100% checklist will ask more of later.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Find the shooting ranges around Leonida and work through every challenge; gold medals need fast, accurate shooting, so use a weapon you are comfortable with and replay a challenge as many times as needed — there is no penalty for retrying. This is also a 100% checklist requirement (42 of 42), so it counts twice toward the Platinum.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 Top Fun locations. The drone races are found at Top Fun venues across the map; win one race at each venue. The 100% checklist also wants all 42 Drone Time Trials completed, so while you are at a venue, run its time trials too.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the same race won twice only counts once, so spread your wins across 20 distinct race events. Races are marked on the map; mix street, off-road and water races. The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge, then out-fish him — hook more or bigger fish than he does within the challenge. Fishing spots are marked on the map; bring patience, the challenge is about steady reeling rather than speed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet — in arcades and some bars around Vice City — and finish a full game; any title counts. The 100% checklist later asks you to play all four video games, so note which ones you have tried.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand opens as a side-character storyline during the campaign; work through his missions in order and the trophy pops at the end of his final one. Side-character finals cannot be missed as long as you finish their strands — do them during the story or in free roam after it.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's strand — he is tied to the treasure sets (5 of 7 needed for 100%) — and the trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Work through Billy's mission strand in order; the trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying Stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as pink-lettered icons on the map; each strand is a short chain of missions for a stranger. Finish any eight strands — there are more than eight available, so you can skip the ones you dislike. Track them in the Strangers & Freaks section of your progress menu.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's mission strand in order; the trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through Tyrone's mission strand in order; the trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 required spots across Leonida (10 locations). THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation is Lucia's, offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she mentions meditating, and choose Accept. That spot becomes unavailable after Chapter 1, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe and make a manual save right after. For the other spots, travel to the marked meditation locations with Jason and Lucia — meditating with both characters at the same spot counts twice toward the 18. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so this trophy needs three more than A Long Road does.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks you to track down specific unique animals across Leonida; complete one of his hunts and the trophy pops. Bret's full strand — all 15 Target Decks — is also a 100% checklist requirement, so keep hunting past the first.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, on the street and in hidden spots. A set is complete when you own every card in it; three full sets pop the trophy. The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so this is the start of a much longer collection — use the WAiNK app to log locations as you go.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan unfamiliar vehicles, landmarks and locations whenever you see the prompt — it logs the spot. Scan early and often during the story: 100 scans is also a 100% checklist requirement, and scanning as you travel saves hours of backtracking later.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are short objectives scattered across the map and activities — stunt, combat, driving and exploration challenges all count. They complete naturally while you play; check the Challenges menu to see which are close. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so keep pushing past 50 and skip the 10 hardest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears — use alleys, the subway or open water to break the search. It is easier in a quieter part of the map, away from police spawns.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, hold up a shop, then immediately hit a second and a third while the wanted level stays up — do not let the heat drop between robberies. Pick three shops close together on the same street and plan your escape route before the first one.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Get in or scan 100 different vehicle models — the WAiNK app logs new models as you encounter them. Drive everything you see during the story; the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models, so this is the first half of a longer scan.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus during a firefight with at least five enemies in view and drop five of them before the effect ends. Pick a busy shootout — a gang operation or a police chase — and save it for a moment with clustered enemies.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a departing passenger aircraft — get on board as it taxis for takeoff and get it airborne. Airport security will be heavy, so come prepared and move fast once you are on the runway.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos appear at military sites and during high wanted levels; steal one, then use its cannon in a fight — destroying vehicles or taking down enemies with it counts. Expect a heavy military response once you are in it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, enter quietly, and take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted by staff or cameras — no witnesses, no alarm. Go at a quiet hour and leave before anyone notices.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big jobs — crack the vault, grab the cash and lose the pursuit each time. Five successful vault jobs pop the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all eight vaults, so keep the crew together for the remaining three; the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 unlocks the vault jobs.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it — ram it or block it — crack it open and take the cash, then lose the police. Trucks spawn on highways and near banks; hit one away from a police station for an easier getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Reveal every region of the map — drive, fly or sail through each area until the map is fully uncovered. It unlocks naturally if you travel for the other trophies, but check the map for fogged corners (islands and the far north) and sweep them deliberately.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations marked on the map; hit at least one operation for every one of the nine gangs. Work through them during the story — gang operations also feed the 100% checklist, which wants all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guide sites — if it does not pop at the first bar, try the beachfront bars at different times of day and check the linked sources for updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's window and out the other side. The exact showroom and method are still being confirmed by the guide sites — check the linked sources for the pinned method once it is verified.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, steal the three key valuables and escape. Case the alley first, grab all three items, and leave before security locks the place down.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train Strength for both characters — gym workouts, melee and heavy lifting raise it — until both hit the maximum. The current guide reading ties this trophy to maxed Strength; the description is deliberately vague and the method is still being confirmed, so check the linked sources if it does not pop.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Your Criminal Profile tracks everything shady you do — robberies, thefts, getaways and the like. Play the way the game wants you to: keep doing criminal acts and the counter climbs. It is a volume trophy; it will land during the 100% grind without special effort.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A story trophy with a deliberately vague description — its unlock method is still unconfirmed by the guide sites. It appears to trigger at a story moment (the description hints at a second attempt succeeding), so play through the campaign and it should pop on its own. Check the linked sources for the confirmed trigger once the guides pin it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A story trophy with a deliberately vague description — its unlock method is still unconfirmed by the guide sites. The title hints at an unusual encounter somewhere in Leonida; play through the story and explore, and check the linked sources once the guides confirm the trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Take out a target with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar, not a gun. The precise method is still being confirmed by the guide sites; check the linked sources for the exact setup once it is verified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; take them to a contact who launders them and keep going until $250,000 has passed through. This is also a 100% checklist requirement, so the laundering you do for the checklist counts here too.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food, car mods — anything in any shop counts toward the total. You will spend most of this naturally on gear and vehicles; if you are short at the end, dump the remainder on expensive clothing or weapon attachments.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every purchasable garage on the map — eight in total. They are marked as properties for sale; you will need serious cash, so save this for after the big story payouts and vault jobs.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles you own or find — ten registrations pop the trophy. Register cars as you acquire them during the story so it completes itself.
